verdict.rationale: Ollama documents using its own Ollama Cloud models alongside local models through the same CLI and API: `ollama launch` works with local or cloud models, and the docs cover both local and cloud base URLs. There is no evidence it connects to third-party cloud providers (e.g., OpenAI or Anthropic models) from within Ollama; the OpenAI and Anthropic API compatibility runs the other way, letting external clients call Ollama. Missing for 10: connecting to third-party cloud AI providers, documented side-by-side mixing of local and cloud models in the app UI, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can connect to cloud AI providers alongside local models within the same interface

citations.quote: Run larger models on Ollama's Cloud without the download.
ollama launch is a new command which sets up and runs coding tools like Claude Code, OpenCode, and Codex with local or cloud models.
